household_budgets_status: Illustrative simultaneously usable runtime-addressable budgets, NOT measured US averages; no claim that memory can be pooled without constraints.
overhead_status: Sensitivity assumptions only, not measurements or guaranteed sufficient allocations. Additional per-device workspace and replication can exceed this envelope.

formulas.kv_gib: 2 * layers * kv_heads * head_dim * context_tokens * concurrent_sequences * kv_bytes_per_element / 2**30

household_baskets.status: Illustrative device-informed baskets, not surveyed US averages, percentile households, or measured feasible allocations. Vendor RAM labels preserved in GB; selected usable budgets in GiB are independent engineering assumptions, not a unit conversion of vendor labels.
household_baskets.other_consented_devices: Fully consenting TVs, routers, consoles, smart fridges, wearables and microcontrollers may still perform useful work; no LLM weight-memory allocation is assumed without runtime access and measurement. Zero budget means uncredited capacity, not zero computing capability.
household_baskets.memory_dominance: In these deliberately chosen budgets, the laptop contributes100% of low capacity and two-thirds of middle/high capacity; phones the remainder. This is a property of scenarios, not a population finding.
household_baskets.validation: Available appRAM, accelerator accessibility, local shards, sharedRAM non-double-counting, thermal dutycycle and interdevice communication require actual measurement. Vendor specification URLs are listed with each device.
